description: For home inspection, this inspection checklist records visual inspection boundary, excluded systems, representative testing, safety limits, and client concerns. Its supporting evidence includes system observations, photos, readings, tested devices, inaccessible areas, seller disclosures, and defect locations.

blocks.guidance: Link this home inspection review to the service record.
blocks.label: Home Inspection Review Reference

blocks.guidance: Confirm the reviewed home inspection location and assets.
blocks.label: Home Inspection Context

sections.guidance: Identify the home inspection service, reviewed areas, crew, and customer.
sections.title: Service Visit Reference

blocks.guidance: Mark each home inspection item after direct review.
items: Report finding and exact property location are identified
Finding classification and stated limitation match the report
Available photo or document reference is linked
Clarification, further evaluation, or repair evidence is recorded
Safety urgency and responsible decision maker are identified
Unresolved questions and specialist referrals remain visible
blocks.label: Home Inspection Task and Area Checks

blocks.guidance: Use one home inspection row for each reviewed area.
blocks.label: Home Inspection Area and Task Results

blocks.guidance: Do not enter unsafe spaces or operate suspect systems; immediately communicate observed urgent safety concerns. Route unresolved home inspection work for review.
blocks.label: Home Inspection Applicable Review Boundary

sections.guidance: Check completed home inspection work by task, room, zone, or equipment.
sections.title: Room and Task Quality Check

blocks.guidance: Keep each home inspection concern open through recheck.

blocks.guidance: Match the home inspection outcome to recorded issues.

subtitle: Home Inspection Inspection Checklist: residential condition inspection and reporting using property, visual inspection boundary, and system observations.
title: Home Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during residential condition inspection and reporting when the home inspection record must identify property, client, occupancy, systems, utilities, weather, access limitations, and inspection agreement. Complete the applicable handoff for material finding summary, limitation record, recommended qualified evaluation, report delivery, and client acknowledgment.
